versions.changelog:
- The bundled script (scripts/pay-and-fetch.js) and package.json were removed; usage is now fully CLI-oriented.
- CLI has been renamed to chartsplat-x402-cli, invoked via npx (no install needed).
- Documentation updates: revised usage instructions, flags, and examples to reflect the CLI-based workflow.
- Candlestick/OHLC usage clarified—now requires a JSON config passed to the CLI.
- Error handling instructions updated to match CLI experience.
- Metadata updated for the new CLI package and version.

- Initial public release of chartsplat-x402.
- Generate PNG charts by paying per request with x402 USDC microtransactions on Base, no API key required.
- Supports line, bar, pie, doughnut, radar, polar area, candlestick, and OHLC chart types.
- Usable via command-line script or Node.js with @x402/fetch v2 packages.
- Requires an EVM wallet with small USDC balance on Base mainnet; payment handled via X402_PRIVATE_KEY.
- Chart requests and payments are transparent, with BaseScan settlement URLs provided for each transaction.
